38081677.clinical_problem: predicting effectiveness of antiseizure medication treatment in children with tuberous sclerosis complex-related epilepsy using MRI and clinical data
38081677.patient_population: 300 children with tuberous sclerosis complex-related epilepsy
38081677.model_description: Combines T2WI/FLAIR (FLAIR3) MRI images with clinical data (age of onset, infantile spasms, medication numbers) as input to a weighted-average ensemble deep learning network, outputting a prediction of antiseizure medication treatment outcome.

38113805.body_region: fetal heart (among other body regions in other benchmark datasets)
38113805.clinical_problem: automatically generating diagnostic reports from medical images, including fetal heart ultrasound, to reduce physician workload
38113805.model_description: Takes medical images (including fetal heart ultrasound) as input and outputs a generated diagnostic text report, using an attention-enhanced relational memory network with dual LSTM.
38113805.release_evidence: Our code is released at https://github.com/llttxx/AERMNET
38113805.headline_result: CIDEr improved 2.4% on fetal heart dataset vs prior models
38113805.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and benchmark comparison study

38127330.clinical_problem: assessing whether adult-trained deep learning CT denoising models generalize safely to pediatric patients of different sizes, to support low-dose CT
38127330.patient_population: computer-simulated pediatric-sized phantoms (newborn to 18 years) and anthropomorphic XCAT phantoms
38127330.model_description: Uses simulated pediatric-sized image-quality phantoms across the newborn-to-18-year size range as input to an adult-trained REDCNN deep-learning CT denoiser, evaluating how image quality metrics change relative to adult phantoms.
38127330.dataset_size: pediatric-sized phantoms spanning newborn to 18 years
38127330.headline_result: 60% noise SD reduction in adult phantoms; reduced denoising performance in smaller pediatric phantoms due to FOV-driven noise texture differences

38129436.model_family: CNN (Deep Fused Linear Triangulation + residual network)
38129436.clinical_problem: early diagnosis of tuberculosis from chest radiographs
38129436.patient_population: 3500 TB and 3500 normal chest radiographs (ages not clearly specified as pediatric-only, mesh indicates Child)
38129436.model_description: Takes posterior-anterior chest radiographs as input, applies a Deep Fused Linear Triangulation preprocessing method to highlight infected regions, and outputs a classification of tuberculosis versus normal using a deep residual learning network.

38151565.clinical_problem: detecting pneumothorax and pleural effusion on pediatric CT to help decide whether tube thoracostomy is needed
38151565.model_description: Takes pediatric chest CT scans as input and outputs detected and localized regions of pneumothorax and pleural effusion using an object-detection deep learning model, to support decisions about tube thoracostomy.

38154374.exclusion_reason: adult population study (young adults aged 21-24); brain age vs polygenic schizophrenia risk, not pediatric imaging

38155152.model_family: hybrid deep learning (U-Net + Bi-LSTM-CNN with metaheuristic optimization)
38155152.clinical_problem: measuring fetal head circumference from ultrasound to monitor fetal growth and health
38155152.patient_population: public benchmark datasets HC18 and ORA-data (ultrasound video frames)
38155152.model_description: Takes fetal ultrasound images/video frames as input, segments the fetal head using a hybrid optimization algorithm and improved U-Net, then estimates head circumference biometry using a hybrid bi-directional LSTM-CNN model.
38155152.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study using public benchmark datasets

38156985.exclusion_reason: adult population study (Veterans Health System, middle-aged/older); liver disease risk prediction, not pediatric

38171053.exclusion_reason: no AI/ML component; graph theory analysis and linear mixed models of diffusion MRI connectivity

38259860.clinical_problem: diagnosing biliary atresia from gallbladder ultrasound images in infants, compared to pediatric radiologists
38259860.patient_population: 4,887 gallbladder ultrasound images from infants with biliary atresia, non-BA hyperbilirubinemia, and healthy infants
38259860.model_description: Takes gallbladder ultrasound images as input and outputs a classification of biliary atresia versus non-BA hyperbilirubinemia versus healthy, using two Mask R-CNN models with different backbone networks, compared against four pediatric radiologists.
38259860.headline_result: Model 2 diagnostic performance exceeded two radiology experts at patient level (p<0.05)
38259860.study_design: retrospective model development and reader comparison study

38486806.clinical_problem: automated segmentation of the placenta and uterine cavity on prenatal MRI to assess placenta accreta spectrum and other pregnancy complications
38486806.patient_population: 241 pregnant women (axial MRI), 101 also with sagittal MRI
38486806.model_description: Takes axial or sagittal prenatal MRI volumes as input and outputs fully automatic 3D segmentation of the uterine cavity and placenta using a deep neural network.
38486806.headline_result: Dice 92% (uterine cavity) and 82% (placenta) on sagittal dataset

39247516.model_family: domain-transfer deep learning with adversarial training
39247516.clinical_problem: automatically predicting the fetal head standard plane from an approaching ultrasound video to assist non-expert operators in acquiring diagnostic-quality images
39247516.model_description: Takes a video sequence approaching the fetal head standard plane as input, using domain-transfer learning to map spatiotemporal video features to a predicted standard-plane image, with adversarial training to preserve realism.

39469044.clinical_problem: segmenting the placenta across BOLD MRI time series to measure placental oxygenation and function, including in fetal growth restriction
39469044.patient_population: 91 subjects (healthy fetuses, fetal growth restriction, high-BMI mothers)
39469044.model_description: Takes BOLD MRI time series volumes of the placenta as input and outputs a temporal placental segmentation mask using a machine learning framework with a placental-boundary-weighted loss.
39469044.headline_result: Boundary-weighting improved Dice by 8.3% (cross-entropy) and 6.0% (signed distance transform)

35032722.clinical_problem: producing bone-suppressed images from pediatric chest radiographs to improve detection of pulmonary disease, since dual-energy subtraction cannot safely be used in children
35032722.patient_population: 129 pediatric digitally reconstructed radiographs used for training data generation
35032722.model_description: Takes standard pediatric chest radiographs as input and outputs a bone-suppressed image using a cascaded deep-learning model, trained via adult CT-derived digitally reconstructed radiographs adapted to pediatric anatomy with a U-Net.
35032722.study_design: retrospective model development and reader evaluation study

35136859.model_family: machine learning (lesion detection algorithm, architecture not specified)
35136859.clinical_problem: detecting focal cortical dysplasia on structural MRI to guide surgical planning in children with drug-resistant epilepsy
35136859.patient_population: children undergoing intracranial evaluation for drug-resistant epilepsy (prospective study protocol)
35136859.model_description: Describes the staged (IDEAL framework) evaluation protocol for an ML lesion-detection algorithm that identifies focal cortical dysplasia from structural brain MRI, intended as an adjunct in planning stereoelectroencephalography trajectories.

35181886.model_family: CNN (deep learning, TW3-C carpal method based)
35181886.clinical_problem: automated carpal bone age assessment for Chinese children based on the China-05 standard
35181886.patient_population: 8184 radiographs of Chinese Han healthy children aged 2-14 years
35181886.model_description: Takes hand/wrist radiographs as input and outputs an automated carpal bone age assessment (epiphysis development stage) using a deep learning model trained on the China-05 standard, compared against radiologist consensus.
35181886.headline_result: 90.5% bone age accuracy rate in clinical test set; MAD 0.20 years

35228070.body_region: brain (neonatal, among other datasets: cardiac, adult brain)
35228070.clinical_problem: generating high-resolution intermediate slices from low-resolution anisotropic MRI without requiring high-resolution training data, evaluated in part on neonatal brain MRI
35228070.patient_population: publicly available neonatal brain MRI dataset (among cardiac cine and adult brain datasets)
35228070.model_description: Takes low-resolution anisotropic MRI slices as input and outputs synthesized intermediate high-resolution slices using an unsupervised autoencoder-based semantic interpolation method, evaluated on neonatal brain, adult brain, and cardiac cine MRI.
35228070.headline_result: Significantly better SSIM and PSNR than cubic B-spline interpolation (p<0.001)

35238352.model_family: machine learning (SVM and others), parcellation-based feature engineering
35238352.clinical_problem: determining how choice of brain surface parcellation and machine learning pipeline affects prediction of phenotypic measures from structural MRI in children
35238352.model_description: Uses parcellation-based summaries of structural MRI as input features to various machine learning pipelines (including support vector machines) to predict 45 phenotypic measures, comparing performance across 220 parcellation schemes.
35238352.headline_result: Higher-resolution parcellations (up to ~4000 parcels) outperformed coarser ones following power-law scaling
35238352.study_design: retrospective methodological comparison study using a large multi-site cohort
